**Issue #3694 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3694: Patch: a finished match's sockets close once its rematch window ends, so the match leaves memory and the server can sleep
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
When an online game ends, the player's browser keeps its connection to the game server open for as long as the tab stays on the result screen, even long after the ten-minute rematch window has closed. While it is open the finished game stays loaded on the server and the server never goes to sleep, so one forgotten tab keeps the hosting bill running all night, which is what the recent change that quiets hidden tabs set out to stop. Once this is built, the server ends those connections when the rematch window ends: the player still sees the result, without the Rematch offer, and the server unloads the game and can sleep.

## Why
- The server refuses a new socket on a finished match once `REMATCH_OFFER_TTL_MS` has passed (`crates/server/src/actor/ws_server.rs:425-443`, `seats_finished_match`; R1285000; SPEC §9.5), but nothing closes one that is already open.
- `Registry::reap_finished` (`crates/server/src/actor/registry.rs:621`) evicts a finished actor only when no seat is present (`PLAYER_IDS.into_iter().all(|home| !presence[home])`), and the co-op registry the same way (`crates/server/src/duos/registry.rs:313`, `!actor.has_open_socket()`). An open socket keeps its actor, its game state and its frames in memory for good.
- The client closes the match socket only when the board unmounts (`apps/web/src/game/net.ts:1154-1158`), and the pings keep it alive, so a tab left on the result screen holds it as long as the tab lives.
- R3576000 (pull request #3576) made hidden tabs let their social socket go because an open WebSocket counts as a request in flight and the container sleeps only after five idle minutes (`SLEEP_AFTER`, `apps/edge/src/index.ts`). It exempts a live match's socket; a finished one's was never addressed. Each such socket also takes one of its address's `WS_MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_ADDRESS` slots.

## Proposal
- On each reaper tick, a finished 1v1 actor past `finished_at + REMATCH_OFFER_TTL_MS` closes its open sockets and is evicted in the same pass; the co-op registry does the same from `ended_at`, the window of R1398000.
- The close uses a final code, one the client never reconnects on (R1115000). The client, which still holds the final view, keeps the result panel up with the rematch offer gone, instead of the refused-socket error line it would show today (`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx:468-477`).
- A ruling in this issue's block, on Hearthstone semantics (the client leaves the game server once the end screen's choices have lapsed), with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<N>.md`.

## Where it lands
- `crates/server/src/actor/registry.rs`, `crates/server/src/actor/match_actor.rs`, `crates/server/src/duos/registry.rs`, and their tests in `crates/server/tests/`
- `apps/web/src/game/net.ts`, `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx` (and the co-op result if it shows the same error)
- SPEC §9.5, §13.8; R672, R1285000, R1398000, R1115000, R3576000

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A server test finishes a 1v1 match with a seat's socket attached, runs `reap_finished(finished_at + REMATCH_OFFER_TTL_MS + 1)`, and sees a close frame on the socket and the match gone from `live()`.
- [ ] Inside the window, the same test keeps the socket and the actor.
- [ ] The same pair for a co-op match.
- [ ] A web test: a finished match's socket closed with that code keeps the result panel, shows no error line and offers no rematch.
- [ ] The ruling's note names its tests, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

## Size and risks
Small to medium: about 4 to 7 files plus the ruling. A rematch offered in the window's last second races the close; the close and the offer's window check must read the same clock under the actor's own lock, as the reaper's check and removal already share the registry's. A watcher of the finished game loses its socket at the same moment, which matches what a reopen is refused today.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-8` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43074670584)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

When a finished match's rematch window ends (`finished_at + REMATCH_OFFER_TTL_MS`), each reaper tick closes the match's open seat and watcher sockets with a new final close code, `MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_CODE` (4411). The same tick evicts the actor, so the match leaves memory and the server can sleep. This covers 1v1 (`finished_at`, R672/R1285000) and co-op (`ended_at`, R1398000). The 1v1 clock is the actor's `finished_at`, which is reset when a finished match is rebuilt.

The clients never reconnect on 4411 (as with R679's 4410). They keep the result panel with no error line and no rematch offer. A new ruling R3694000 records the rule, and its note names its tests.

## Files to touch

## Steps

1. **Constant.** In `crates/server/src/config.rs`, add `MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_CODE: u16 = 4411` after `MATCH_VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE`, with a doc comment (R3694000). It is in the 4000–4999 range and means the finished match's rematch window is over. The client never reconnects on it. 4411 is unused (checked).

2. **1v1 actor** (`actor/match_actor.rs`).
   - Rename `fn halt(&self)` to `fn halt_with(&self, code: u16, reason: &str)`.
   - In its body, replace `socket.close(Some(1001), Some("the actor is going away"))` with `socket.close(Some(code), Some(reason))`. Replace `self.spectate_close(CLOSE_GOING_AWAY, "the actor is going away")` with `self.spectate_close(code, reason)`.
   - Make `fn halt(&self)` a one-line wrapper: `self.halt_with(CLOSE_GOING_AWAY, "the actor is going away")`. Keep the other callers of `halt` untouched.
   - Add this next to `stop`:
     ```rust
     /// R3694000: `stop` for a finished match past its rematch window; sockets close with MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_CODE.
     pub async fn stop_match_over(&self) {
         self.halt_with(MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_CODE, MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_REASON);
         self.idle().await;
     }
     ```
   - Import `MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_CODE` in the existing `use crate::config::{…}` at line ~57. `MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_REASON` is already defined in this file.
   - `halt_with` still takes the sockets under the actor's lock after `DuelEvent::Stop`, so no grace is stored (as today).

3. **1v1 reaper** (`actor/registry.rs`, `reap_finished`).
   - Change the filter to `actor.finished_at().is_some_and(|finished_at| !in_rematch_window(Some(finished_at), now))`. Drop the presence clause and the `PLAYER_IDS` use if it becomes unused.
   - Import it with `use crate::api::rematch::in_rematch_window;`. `crates/server/src/api/rematch.rs:129` re-exports it as `pub(crate)`. It is the same predicate the socket-refusal check uses (`ws_server.rs`), and `now - f > TTL` is its negation, so the boundary is unchanged.
   - In the eviction loop, call `actor.stop_match_over().await` instead of `actor.stop().await`.
   - Rewrite the doc comment: R672 and R3694000 say that past the window the actor is evicted and its sockets closed with 4411. Remove the line "An open socket keeps its actor".
   - The check and the removal still share the `actors` lock. The caller passes one `now` per tick (`api/results.rs:826`).

4. **Co-op actor** (`duos/actor.rs`). Make the same `halt`/`halt_with`/`stop_match_over` split (around lines 1156–1177). The existing `use crate::actor::match_actor::{MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_REASON, …}` already provides the reason. Import `MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_CODE` from `crate::config`.

5. **Co-op reaper.**
   - In `duos/registry.rs`, change the signature to `pub async fn reap_finished(&self, now: i64) -> Vec<String>`.
   - Due when `actor.is_finished() && ((!actor.has_open_socket() && actor.watcher_count() == 0) || actor.finished_at().is_some_and(|at| !in_again_window(at, now)))`. The first branch is today's immediate eviction of a finished actor with nobody attached. The second is the new one.
   - Import `jackioh_shared::host::again::in_again_window`, as `duos/again.rs:20` does. Call `actor.stop_match_over().await` when evicting. Update the doc comment.
   - In `duos/mod.rs:255`, change the call to `held.reap_finished(now).await;` (`now` already exists in `sweep`).
   - The co-op `finished_at` is when the result was written, or when the actor was rebuilt. It is the same clock the 1v1 side uses.

6. **Web clients.**
   - `apps/web/src/game/net.ts`, after `VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE`:
     ```ts
     /** R3694000: the server closes a finished match's sockets with this once its rematch window ends; final. */
     export const MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_CODE = 4411;
     ```
     In `onclose`, change `if (event.code === VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE)` to `if (event.code === VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE || event.code === MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_CODE)`. The branch patches `connection: "closed"` and sets no error. `onclose` has already cleared `rematch` and `series`. Extend the `"closed"` doc in `ConnectionState`.
   - `apps/web/src/duos/socket.ts` (line ~408): import `MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_CODE` from `../game/net.ts` beside `VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE`. Use `stopped || event.code === VOIDED_CLOSE_CODE || event.code === MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_CODE`.
   - `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx` (line ~442). Move `const voided = view.result?.reason === "voided";` above `gone`. Then `const gone = match.connection === "closed" && (view.result === null || voided);`. A finished, non-voided match closed by 4411 shows no "This match is no longer available" alert. The board's `error` prop stays null because net.ts sets none, and `RematchButtons` already renders null unless `connection === "open"`.
   - `DuosRoute.tsx` needs no change: it shows no gone notice once a view is up. Do not edit it.

7. **Fix existing server tests** that assert the old behaviour (the builder verifies by running the full suite, step list under Tests):
   - `tests/actor/match_actor.rs`, `mod a_finished_actor_leaves_the_registry_after_its_rematch_window`, first test. Delete the block "Past it, an open socket still keeps the actor…" (its 3 asserts). Keep "window still open at its last ms" with sockets open (`reap_finished(window_end)` is empty and `has` is true). The rest of the test (drop transports, weak and task counts) stays.
   - `tests/api/rematch.rs`, first test (~lines 1113–1118). Delete the block "Past it, an open socket still holds the actor, and so the opponent's presence". The sockets are then closed by `transport_closed()` as before, and the later `reap_finished(window_end + 1)` returns `[finished]`.
   - `tests/api/rematch.rs`, `an_offer_outlives_its_window_while_the_finished_match_is_held` (~1150). The reaper now evicts at `late` even with sockets open. Reorder:
     1. At `late` with the actor still held, `sweep_rematch_offers(&app, late) == 0` and the status still shows `youOffered`.
     2. Then `reap_finished(late)` returns `[finished]`. Do not call `transport_closed()` first. Assert `p1`/`p2` are closed with code 4411 if the `Socket` helper exposes it. Otherwise assert `!p1.is_open()`.
     3. Then `sweep_rematch_offers(&app, late) == 1` and `rematch_offer_count(&app) == 0`.
   - Update that test's doc comment.

8. **Spec.**
   - `spec/rulings/R3694000.md`. Copy the format of `spec/rulings/R3576000.md`.
     - Front matter: `id: R3694000`; a `title`; `cards: "§9.5, §13.8, R672, R679, R1115000, R1285000, R1398000, R3576000, issue #3694"`; `proven_in:` listing every file in the Tests section below (Rust and web).
     - Body: **Why**, **The rule**, **Hearthstone semantics**, **Rejected**.
     - **Why**: an open match socket kept a finished actor, its state and the container awake, and held an address slot. R3576000 had exempted it.
     - **The rule**: past `finished_at + REMATCH_OFFER_TTL_MS`, on each reaper tick, a finished 1v1 actor (from `finished_at`) or co-op actor (from `ended_at`) closes its seat and watcher sockets with 4411 and is evicted in the same pass. 4411 is final for the client, as 4410 and, per R1115000, 4403/4404 are. The client keeps the final view and result panel with no error line and no rematch offer.
     - **Hearthstone semantics**: the client leaves the game server once the end screen's choices have lapsed.
     - **Rejected**: reusing 1001, which the client reconnects on (it would loop against the 4404-style refusal of `seats_finished_match`). Closing without evicting. Keeping the socket while a watcher is present.
     - **Decisions**:
       - A rebuilt actor's window opens at the rebuild, so a socket on it may outlive the row's window by up to one TTL. This matches today's reaper.
       - Watchers of the finished game are closed in the same pass.
       - The offer path reads the row's `finished_at` and `now_ms()` with `in_rematch_window`. The close uses the same predicate on the tick's `now`, so it fires only strictly after the window. An offer the book accepted at or before the window's end survives the close. The client's `RematchWatcher` poll starts once the socket drops and still navigates to the created match. No offer path through the actor lock is added.
   - `spec/pending/3694.md`: one paragraph in the style of `spec/pending/3674.md`: `**[[R3694000]] …title… (issue #3694, 2026-11-11; amends [[R672]], [[R1398000]])**: …`. Include why, the rule, what is rejected, and which sections it edits.
   - `spec/09-architecture.md` line 68: after "…watched from the replays list ([[R1285000]])." add: "A finished match's open sockets are closed with 4411, which no client reconnects on, once that window ends, and its actor leaves memory ([[R3694000]])."
   - `spec/13-duos.md` line 144: after "…watched from its replay ([[R1398000]])." add the same for a co-op match, counted from `ended_at` ([[R3694000]]).

## Tests

All Rust test names start with `r3694000_` (the token `r3694000` must be `_`-delimited).

- **`crates/server/tests/actor/match_actor.rs`**
  - `r3694000_a_finished_match_closes_its_sockets_once_its_window_ends` (`#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]`). Use `harness(Options::default())`. `send(&h, &h.p1, "resign", json!({"type":"concede"}))`. `window_end = h.actor.finished_at().unwrap() + REMATCH_OFFER_TTL_MS`. Assert:
    - `reap_finished(window_end)` is empty, `has(MATCH_ID)` is true, and both clients are open (**inside the window**).
    - `reap_finished(window_end + 1)` returns `[MATCH_ID]`. `h.app.matches.live()` is empty. `h.p1.close_code()` and `h.p2.close_code()` are `Some(MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_CODE)` (**past it**).
    - Import the constant from `jackioh_server::config`.
  - `r3694000_a_live_match_keeps_its_sockets_whatever_the_clock`. A running match with sockets open is not reaped at `now() + REMATCH_OFFER_TTL_MS + 1`.
- **`crates/server/tests/actor/duos.rs`**, a new `mod r3694000_the_coop_window`.
  - `r3694000_a_finished_coop_match_closes_its_sockets_once_its_window_ends`. Use `duos("easy")`, `h.seat(&h.host)`, `h.seat(&h.guest)`, `h.concede_both(&a1, &a2)`. `ended = registry(&h.app).get(&h.match_id).unwrap().finished_at().unwrap()`.
    - `registry(&h.app).reap_finished(ended + REMATCH_OFFER_TTL_MS)` is empty. `has` is true. `a1.close_code().is_none()` (**inside**).
    - `reap_finished(ended + REMATCH_OFFER_TTL_MS + 1)` returns `[h.match_id]`. `a1.wait_closed(PROMPTLY)` and `a2.wait_closed(PROMPTLY)` are `Some(4411)`. `!registry.has(...)`.
    - `crate::...::sweep` calls in the existing tests stay valid.
- **Web**
  - `apps/web/src/game/net.test.ts`, next to the R679 test (line ~850): `it("R3694000 a finished match's close (4411) is final: no reconnect, the last view and no error kept")`. Deliver a view, `h.socket().drop(4411, "the match is over")`. Expect `connection === "closed"`, `error === null`, the view kept, `h.pending() === 0`.
  - `apps/web/src/duos/socket.test.ts`, next to line ~310: `it("R3694000 a co-op finished match's close (4411) is final: no reconnect, the last view kept")`.
  - `apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx`, a new `describe` near the R3213000 block (line ~1385), reusing `stubPostGameFetch(null)`, `deliver`, `pushView`, `FINISHED` and `settle`:
    - Name: `it("R3694000 a finished match's socket closed with 4411 keeps the result panel, shows no error line and offers no rematch")`.
    - Deliver a `rematch` frame (`opponentHere: true`, like the R3213000 test). `pushView(FINISHED)`. Assert `screen.getByTestId("rematch-offer")` or `rematch-incoming` exists.
    - Then `act(() => live().onclose?.({ code: 4411, reason: "the match is over", wasClean: true }))` and `await settle({ advance: 0 })`. Assert `result-overlay` is present, `queryByTestId("action-error")` is null, `queryByTestId("match-gone")` is null, and `rematch-offer`, `rematch-double` and `rematch-incoming` are null. `match-status` has `data-connection="closed"`. `sockets` has length 1.
    - Import `MATCH_OVER_CLOSE_CODE` from `../game/net.ts`.
  - The existing `#1899` voided tests must stay green: a voided result still shows `match-gone`.

**Commands**
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server r3694000`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server` (the full suite: it catches any other test that leaves sockets open past the window)
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/net.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/duos/socket.test.ts`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/match.test.tsx`
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`

## Done when

- [ ] A 1v1 test closes a seat's socket with 4411 and the match is gone from `live()` after `reap_finished(finished_at + REMATCH_OFFER_TTL_MS + 1)`.
- [ ] The same test keeps the socket and the actor at `finished_at + REMATCH_OFFER_TTL_MS`.
- [ ] The same pair passes for co-op.
- [ ] The web test shows the result panel kept, no error line and no rematch after the 4411 close.
- [ ] The three old assertions (step 7) are rewritten, not deleted, and the full `jackioh-server` suite is green.
- [ ] The ruling note, the pending paragraph and the two spec sentences are written, and the note's `proven_in` lists the real test files. `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, clippy on `jackioh-server` and the web typecheck, eslint and unit tests pass.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` has been run.
- [ ] No `#[ignore]` or `#[allow]` was added and no check was weakened.

## Risks

- **Rematch race at the window's last second.** The close fires only on `!in_rematch_window` for the tick's `now`, so an offer accepted at or before the window's end is already in the book. After the socket drops, the client's poll resumes and navigates to the created match (step 8 decision). Do not add new clocks.
- **Client loops on the wrong code.** 1001 (reconnect + refusal error line) would loop. 4411 must be in both `net.ts` and `duos/socket.ts`.
- **Watchers.** They get 4411 too. `together/WatchRoute.tsx` has no close-code handling, so nothing loops.
- **Purity and rule 9.** The server is not a pure crate. The constant lives in `config.rs`. The client hard-codes 4411 as it does 4410.
- **Test timing.** The reaper uses the passed `now`, not the clock. Use `start_paused` tests as the neighbours do.

## Open questions

None. The following were decided without one:
- The code is 4411.
- Watchers are closed with the same code.
- A rebuilt actor's window opens at its rebuild.
- A co-op actor with nobody attached is still evicted at once (as today).
````
